The '''Ord Canfre system''' was a star system located within the [[Cassander sector/Legends|Cassander sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the planet [[Ord Canfre/Legends|Ord Canfre]].
